title: State v. Fair (N.J. 2024)
citation: State v. Fair, N.J. Supreme Court, No. A-20-22, decided Jan. 16, 2024
key_points: Recklessness can support a true-threats prosecution under 2C:12-3(a), but there is also an objective test: a reasonable person in the victim's position would have seen the message as threatening violence.
Subsections (a) and (b) of 2C:12-3 are separate, alternative crimes; a jury must agree unanimously on which one was committed.
officer_notes: When charging, specify 2C:12-3(a) or (b) rather than 'a and/or b'.
